input.prompt: Photograph of a minimal travertine stone showroom in late afternoon. Low warm sunlight enters from a tall window on the left and casts long diagonal shadows of the window mullions across the textured travertine wall and floor. In the centre stands a single solid travertine plinth, and on it an open silver MacBook Pro seen from a slight three-quarter front angle; its screen faces the camera and shows one plain uniform soft white-grey glow and nothing else. Linen curtain edge on the left. 50mm lens at f/2.8, shallow depth of field, background softly out of focus. Shot on a Sony A7R V, true-to-life colour, realistic exposure, fine natural grain, restrained cinematic grade with soft highlights and warm shadows. Quiet luxury, architectural photography. No people. No readable text anywhere, no logos, no watermark.
